what: Four server pause points in the two mint paths, each asking the stack's gate service whether to go on: commitDraft before and after it reads the base and draft files (a commit that read its draft before or after another commit deleted it, S4b), and commitNewVersion (update_document, /publish?update=, the CLI) before it chooses the version id and between its upload and its transaction (S4, C9, C9b). Its own helper (functions/src/lib/e2eRaceGate.ts), so it applies alone or beside amplify-mint-join, whose commitDraft gates the C8 S4 case also needs

gates.name: commit-before-read
gates.where: functions/src/lib/draft.ts commitDraft: after the endpoint's base check and the open-threads refusal, before the base and draft files are read

gates.name: commit-after-read
gates.where: functions/src/lib/draft.ts commitDraft: after the base and draft files are read, before they are hashed and the content-hash dedup is asked

gates.name: update-before-id
gates.where: functions/src/lib/publish.ts commitNewVersion: after the dedup and every refusal (editors, pending, accepted in the draft), before the version id is chosen (max(N)+1)

gates.name: update-after-upload
gates.where: functions/src/lib/publish.ts commitNewVersion: between the upload of v(N+1)/ and the transaction that makes it current
